name: coderabbit-review
description: Runs a local CodeRabbit CLI review of the current branch and reports, or optionally fixes, the findings

interface.shortDescription: Run a local CodeRabbit review of your current changes
interface.longDescription: Runs `coderabbit review --agent --fresh` on the current Git branch or uncommitted changes and summarises the findings. On explicit request it validates each finding against the code, fixes the valid ones and runs the repo's lint, typecheck and tests. It never commits, pushes or opens PRs.
defaultPrompt: Run a CodeRabbit review of my current changes.
